name: RBF Approximation of Subdivision Basis Functions
definition: A method to approximate the continuous volumetric basis function of a subdivision scheme using Radially Symmetric Basis Function (RBF) kernels, avoiding explicit tessellation and subdivision of complex polyhedra.
summary: RBF Approximation of Subdivision Basis Functions replaces expensive recursive subdivision with efficient Radial Basis Function evaluation, enabling interactive GPU volume splatting without explicit mesh connectivity.
